annotations.text: 1 · The Workbench, nothing selected. Left: Library. Center: 12-column canvas (note the Container). Right: page settings + shared Theme. No Mode switch — this one surface replaces Gallery / Component / Compose.
2 · Select one node → its manifest controls, grouped Content / Appearance / Behaviour + a Layout section. Theme-driven props carry a detachable 'theme' chip (Q6).
3 · Select a Container → stack controls (direction / gap / align / padding) + grid span + Publish as component. The left rail is flipped to the Outline node tree (Q4, Q7).
4 · Select several → the intersection of common props (by name + kind) + align / distribute + bulk span. 'Mixed' means values differ; set it to unify (Q9).
5 · Drag a component from the Library onto the grid. A drop indicator shows the insertion point and resulting span; the node lands selected. Keyboard + span buttons remain as fallbacks (Q3).

6 · My Library — the saved-composition store that today does not exist, so 'open an existing composition' finally has something to open. Share = URL link; opening a link imports. Old Variants migrate in as single-node items (Q5).
7 · Below 900px the three regions collapse to Library / Canvas / Controls tabs. minSpan forces nodes full-width; authored spans return on Desktop. No fake status bar.
